items.name: FF · Payments in
items.what: Receives Paystack webhooks, checks the signature and the transaction with Paystack, skips duplicate references, then onboards new clients automatically (Clients row, welcome pack, Telegram alert, intake follow-up) and answers failed monthly charges with a friendly reminder instead of a shutdown.
setup: Use Paystack TEST mode only. Create a payment page per tier deposit (e.g. Growth: 50% setup, ₦425,000) with a custom field "Business name" and the tier in its metadata or a custom field "Tier", and a monthly plan per tier.
On your n8n server set the environment variables PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY (your TEST secret key), NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto and N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, then restart n8n.

Create a Header Auth credential called "Paystack test": Name Authorization, Value Bearer followed by your TEST secret key. Select it in Verify transaction, Verify subscription and Get update-card link.

Create a Google Sheet with tabs Payments (reference, date, business, email, tier, kind, amount_ngn), Clients (business, contact, email, tier, amount, reference, date, status, retainer, last_paid, plan, subscription_code, next_payment_date), Intake (email plus your form answers) and Log (date, event, reference, detail). Replace YOUR_SHEET_ID in every Google Sheets node and select a Google Sheets credential.
Select a Gmail credential in the three Gmail nodes and a Telegram credential in the Telegram nodes; replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID with Tolu's chat ID.
Replace YOUR_SCOPE_LINK, YOUR_BOOKING_LINK and YOUR_INTAKE_FORM_LINK in the email texts.
Edit the TIERS table in "Check status and amount" to your own deposit and monthly amounts.
Publish the workflow, copy the PRODUCTION webhook URL into Paystack's test webhook settings, and set Settings → Error workflow to your error workflow (3.6).
items.test: Pay a test deposit page with Paystack's test card: one Payments row, one Clients row, a welcome email and a Telegram message within a minute. Resend the same event from the dashboard: it stops at "Duplicate: skip". POST a made-up body from Hoppscotch: it stops at "Signature valid?" and a signature_rejected row appears in Log. Trigger a failed subscription charge: a friendly reminder email and a Telegram note arrive, and nothing is switched off.

walk.title: Build it: pay, verified, onboarded
walk.sample: Paystack TEST · Okonkwo Pharmacy pays the Growth deposit, ₦425,000 · then the same event resent · then a failed monthly charge

steps.say: Everything here runs in Paystack test mode first: a payment page per tier's deposit with a Business name field and the tier, and a monthly plan per tier.
show: Custom field: Business name · metadata: tier

steps.say: Paystack posts to this webhook, with the raw body kept, because the signature is computed on the exact bytes. Publish it and paste the production URL into Paystack, not the test URL.
Verification one: an HMAC SHA512 of the raw body with your secret key must equal Paystack's signature header. The test secret key lives in one place, the n8n environment.
We reply 200 to Paystack straight away. A made-up POST stops here and is logged as signature rejected, so a fake payment can never onboard anyone.
Then we route by event: a successful charge, a new subscription, or a failed monthly invoice. Anything else is logged for review.
Verification two: only Paystack's own answer counts. We ask Paystack about this reference, with the key in a Header Auth credential.
The status must be success, in naira, and the amount must match the tier exactly. Paystack counts in kobo, so 425,000 naira is 42.5 million kobo.
If anything doesn't match, nothing happens to the client, and Tolu gets a note to check it in the dashboard.
show: Paystack event NOT acted on · Why: …

steps.say: Paystack can send the same event more than once. If the reference is already in Payments, we skip it, so no one gets three welcome packs.
We record the payment first, so the next copy of this event is caught as a duplicate.
show: reference, date, business, tier, kind, amount_ngn

steps.say: A deposit means a new client: a Clients row with status Onboarding.
Within a minute, the welcome pack: thanks, the signed scope, what happens week by week, the kick-off booking link and the intake form.
show: Subject: Welcome to your automation project…
Scope · Week 1–4 plan · booking · intake form

steps.say: Tolu gets a Telegram, so no client ever pays and hears nothing.
Two days later, if the intake form isn't in, a gentle reminder goes to the client and Tolu is told.
A failed monthly charge starts a conversation, not a shutdown. Paystack doesn't retry it, so we send a card-update link and say everything keeps running.
Tolu gets a note, it's logged, and three days later she's reminded to check in kindly. Attach the error workflow, so a paid client who fails onboarding alerts you at once.
show: Note to Tolu · Log failed charge
Wait 3 days → Check in today… nothing is switched off

walk.end: Pay the test deposit: one payment row, one client row, a welcome email and a Telegram within a minute; resend it and it stops at Duplicate: skip.
